title: Android TextView: compound drawable tint modes
purpose: Compare the supported Android XML drawableTintMode values on the same compound drawable.
changes: Added src_in, src_atop, src_over, multiply, screen and add tint modes for solid compound shapes on TextView and CheckedTextView.
steps: Find Android XML compound drawable tint modes below the switches. Each row names a tint mode and shows the same amber shape tinted with translucent blue.
Compare the shapes: src_in appears translucent blue, src_atop mixes blue and amber, and multiply appears dark. The remaining modes have their own resulting colors; the labels remain unchanged.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and check that the shapes move to the other side while keeping their colors and spacing.
Choose OK if the example displays correctly, or Reject and describe the row, the problem and your device.
expected: Each mode composes the blue tint with the original amber drawable independently of the text, and the drawable follows the layout direction.
limits: This covers solid XML compound shapes only; other drawable kinds, additional blend modes, antialiased edge compositing and Android device pixel parity remain open.

references.scope: Compound drawable tint mode XML and application.

validation: 147 Android XML importer tests passed, including all six modes and invalid inputs.
Rust rendering checks cover src_in and src_atop colors, the default mode, and existing RTL and state behavior.
